name: Member's Mark Artisan Sourdough Sandwich Bread (2-Pack)
whyItWorks: Pre-sliced sourdough bread made with fermented starter. The fermentation process lowers gluten elasticity and fructan content, easing digestion compared to standard sandwich white bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly for breakfast toast or sandwiches. Soft crumb is very easy to chew.
